node.label: 步骤 1. 确定传递函数：H(s)=L{系统脉冲响应}。通过以下方法计算 H(s)：(a) 对运动方程求拉普拉斯变换。(b) 求解所得代数方程。步骤 2. 确定输入信号的拉普拉斯变换：U(s)=L{u(t)}。步骤 3. 计算输出的拉普拉斯变换：Y(s)=H(s)U(s)。步骤 4. 对 Y(s) 进行部分分式展开。步骤 5. 通过计算步骤 4 中 Y(s) 的拉普拉斯反变换求得系统输出 y(t)=L^{-1}{Y(s)}：(a) 在变换对表格中查找 y(t) 的各分量。(b) 组合各分量以所需形式给出总解。
node.description: STEP 1. Determine the transfer function: H(s)=L{impulse response of the system}. Compute H(s) by: (a) Take the Laplace transform of the equations of motion. (b) Solve the resulting algebraic equations. STEP 2. Determine the Laplace transform of the input signal: U(s)=L{u(t)}. STEP 3. Compute the Laplace transform of the output: Y(s)=H(s)U(s). STEP 4. Break up Y(s) by partial-fraction expansion. STEP 5. Find the output of the system by computing the inverse Laplace transform of Y(s) in Step 4, y(t)=L^{-1}{Y(s)}: (a) Look up the components of y(t) in a table of transform-time function pairs. (b) Combine the components to give the total solution in the desired form.
